newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady, gas oil firmer with IPE.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady, gas oil firmer with IPE.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline was steady but the market was becalmed. Eurograde barges traded early at $192 a tonne fob ARA and no business was heard done since then, but late offers were as high as $195.50.
Spot gas oil prices were firmer with gas oil futures.
Traders saw good buying from German wholesalers with barges traded several time at July IPE +25 cents.

High sulphur barges traded early at $86 fob Rotterdam, or $1.50 below the highest deal a day earlier, but were later sold by a trading house at numbers as low as $84 in a bid to push down prices. A major was said to have bid the higher prices in an attempt to push the market up.
High sulphur cargoes were quiet while one percent was talked slightly stronger at $95 fob.
